verdict.rationale: Docusaurus is a code-first static site generator: content is MDX files [docusaurus-docs-2], customization is config and React components [docusaurus-docs-4], and operations run through a CLI [docusaurus-docs-11]. It has no separate management UI and no service API, so asking whether an API matches the UI is a category error for this kind of product. Everything is already done programmatically through files and the CLI, and the 404 OpenAPI probe reflects that there is no hosted service, not a missing capability.
